description: Merge a duplicate client into another. id = the duplicate to absorb (it is archived/soft-deleted); into = the surviving client_id to keep. Moves the duplicate's bookings, contacts, comments, todos and groupings onto the survivor. Use this to fix a booking created under a new/duplicate client instead of the existing one, or to clean up a pair from find_duplicates.

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.
